description: Non-technical audiences: audience profiling, exec summaries, decision logs, and guides. Decks live in the design pack.

first-value.starter-task: Turn a long document into a one-page summary for leadership
first-value.starter-prompt: Turn this design doc into a one-page executive summary for our steering committee: <paste the doc>.
first-value.verification: exec-summary returns a one-page summary that a time-poor reader can act on in 30 seconds, written without jargon.
first-value.recovery: If exec-summary does not activate, ask for it by name ("use exec-summary") and check that its folder exists in your skills folder (`~/.claude/skills/` by default).

journey.when: You need to turn a long document or a meeting into something a non-technical or time-poor audience can act on.
you_bring: the long document, such as a design doc or proposal
notes or a transcript from the meeting where it was discussed
who the audience is, such as a steering committee or an exec sponsor

steps.you_do: Paste the meeting notes, thread or transcript.
steps.you_get: A structured log of decisions, action items, owners and due dates you can paste into a doc or tracker.

steps.you_do: Say who will read it, in your own words.
steps.you_get: The audience archetype with its rules: length, density, tone, must-have sections and things to never include.

steps.you_do: Hand it the long document, the decisions, and the audience profile.
steps.you_get: A one-page summary a time-poor reader can act on in 30 seconds, without jargon.

steps.you_do: Run it on the summary before it goes out.
steps.you_get: A verdict and severity-tagged findings, such as a missing Ask, each with a suggested fix.
steps.decide: Ship, ship with the listed changes, or rewrite.

steps.you_do: Run it on the final version.
steps.you_get: The text with machine artifacts stripped and any prose tells quoted with rewrites.

journey.you_end_with: A decision log with owners and dates, and a reviewed one-page summary ready to send.
